title: Kite
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- kite diamond body -->
  <polygon points='50,14 78,44 50,78 22,44' fill='#ffd23f'/>
  <!-- kite inner panels for clarity -->
  <polygon points='50,14 64,44 50,78 36,44' fill='#ff8c42'/>
  <!-- spine -->
  <line x1='50' y1='14' x2='50' y2='78' stroke='#e8473f' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- cross spar -->
  <line x1='22' y1='44' x2='78' y2='44' stroke='#e8473f' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- kite tail -->
  <path d='M50 78 Q44 86 52 92 Q58 97 50 100' fill='none' stroke='#e8473f' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tail bows -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='85' r='3.5' fill='#4fb8e8'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='94' r='3.5' fill='#4fb8e8'/>
  <!-- sparkle highlights on kite -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#fff7c2'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='44' r='2' fill='#fff7c2'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='44' r='2' fill='#fff7c2'/>
</svg>
